system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
The Seller’s **[STANDARD] labels and “efficiency note” do not establish Buyer agreement**. All positions remain reviewable. This review is based on the supplied summaries and Disclosure Letter, not the underlying SPA or DD documents.

The numerical counterpositions below are **proposed Buyer negotiating positions**, not previously agreed terms.

| Issue | Seller’s position | What the Buyer should want | Recommendation and one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001 — General liability cap** | General warranty liability capped at **20% / AUD 4.8m**. | A materially higher general cap, with separate treatment for fundamental warranties, tax, specific indemnities and fraud. | **Counter at 100% of the AUD 24m price**, negotiating any reduction against the overall protection package; a 20% cap leaves substantial acquisition risk with Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-002 — De minimis & basket** | Claims must exceed **AUD 25,000**; **AUD 250,000 deductible basket**, with only the excess recoverable. | Lower thresholds, a tipping basket, aggregation of related claims and exclusions for specially protected claims. | **Propose AUD 10,000 de minimis and AUD 100,000 tipping basket**, aggregating related claims; the proposed deductible permanently transfers the first AUD 250,000 of qualifying losses to Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-003 — General claims time limit** | General warranty notification within **18 months**; time limits apply to all Claims unless expressly excluded. | At least **24 months** for general warranties, longer category-specific periods and preservation of timely notified claims. | **Seek 24–36 months**, reasonable notice requirements and adequate time to commence proceedings after notification; 18 months may expire before latent issues emerge through full reporting cycles. |
| **SPA-N-004 — Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties share the general cap and time limits. | Separate warranties covering capacity, authority, ownership, valid issuance, all issued shares and freedom from encumbrances; no basket or de minimis. | **Require a separate purchase-price cap and substantially longer survival**, with fraud unaffected; defective ownership or authority undermines the entire acquisition, not merely business value. |
| **SPA-N-005 — Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedies and non-reliance apply to all Claims; no express fraud exception is identified. | An express fraud and fraudulent concealment carve-out from caps, thresholds, time bars, disclosure, knowledge and remedy restrictions, preserving non-excludable rights. | **Reject the blanket application and insert an overriding carve-out**, including appropriately attributed Seller representative conduct; contractual protections must not shelter fraudulent conduct. |
| **SPA-N-006 — Disclosure scope** | Blanket disclosure of the indexed data room, accounts, registers and public records, including material “referred to” in them. | Only fair disclosure with sufficient detail to identify the nature and scope of the matter, against identified warranties, in a fixed and accessible record. | **Reject blanket and incorporation-by-reference disclosure**; permit only tightly defined agreed general disclosures and specific fair disclosures, because document availability alone does not meaningfully identify risk. |
| **SPA-N-007 — Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for matters known by Buyer or advisers, including matters discoverable from the data room or public records. | No constructive or imputed knowledge exclusion; preferably no knowledge bar beyond agreed fair disclosure. | **Delete the discoverability test and adviser attribution**; if unavoidable, limit to actual conscious knowledge of named Buyer individuals, proved by Seller, because a diligence opportunity should not extinguish warranty protection. |
| **SPA-N-008 — Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; consent deemed satisfied on delivery of written consent, despite associated conditions and no final consent currently supplied. | A Buyer-protective condition precedent requiring valid, effective consent and satisfaction of clause 11.3 conditions without unacceptable commercial changes. | **Require evidence of consent and fulfilment of all conditions before Completion**, waivable only by Buyer, with a long-stop termination right; approximately 30% of FY26 revenue depends on this relationship. |
| **SPA-N-009 — Riverlark facility** | Approximately **AUD 3.2m** outstanding; security release to follow Completion. | Full debt payoff through Completion funds flow, appropriate purchase-price deduction and effective release of all relevant security and guarantees at Completion. | **Require a lender payoff letter and binding simultaneous discharge arrangements**, followed by verification of registrations being removed; Buyer should not acquire a debt-free business subject to residual lender claims or security. |
| **SPA-N-010 — Employee bonuses** | **AUD 420,000** conditional bonuses described as Seller’s matter but omitted from funds flow; on-costs unspecified. | Seller-funded treatment of transaction-triggered liabilities, including applicable payroll tax, superannuation and other on-costs, without double counting. | **Quantify and expressly allocate the bonuses and on-costs**, reflecting them in funds flow, price adjustments or secured Seller reimbursement as appropriate; omission risks Buyer funding Seller’s transaction costs after Completion. |
| **SPA-N-011 — Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity limited to the specific SOW3 payment; transfer depends on cleared payment of every SOW3 fee, with **AUD 180,000** recorded open and no receipt or confirmatory assignment. | Verified payment and effective IP ownership at Completion, plus protection against losses from pre-Completion payment or chain-of-title defects. | **Require payment evidence and a confirmatory assignment, and broaden the indemnity** to resulting title disputes, remediation and third-party claims under a separate regime; paying the invoice alone may not resolve ownership or consequential exposure. |
| **SPA-N-012 — Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary operational matter said unlikely to be material; access, scope, notification duties and loss remain unresolved. | Prompt investigation, containment, evidence preservation, lawful notification assessment, Buyer oversight and protection for pre-Completion incident liabilities. | **Require investigation deliverables and a specific indemnity, supported by retention if needed**; uncertainty over the approximately 1,240 potentially affected records is neither proof of a notifiable breach nor a basis to dismiss the risk. |
| **SPA-N-013 — Sandbar renewals** | Three **AUD 110,000** renewals treated as ordinary-course costs. | Combined assessment of the **AUD 330,000** commitment, including timing, scope, necessity, termination rights and accounting treatment. | **Review DD-008 and DD-011 together and restrict unapproved commitments pending Completion**; classify any adjustment only after verification, because neither ordinary-course status nor debt-like treatment is established. |
| **SPA-N-014 — Category separation** | General limitations, exclusive remedies, non-reliance and time bars extend to all Claims unless expressly excluded. | Distinct regimes for general warranties, fundamental warranties, tax, specific indemnities, payment obligations, covenants and fraud. | **Insert an express claims-category matrix and precedence provision**, with targeted exceptions throughout the SPA; broad definitions must not silently neutralise negotiated protections or payment obligations. |
| **SPA-N-015 — Title verification** | DD-012 share register relied on as evidence Seller owns 100%. | Independent reconciliation of the register, issued capital, certificates, transfers, constitutional restrictions, options and other equity rights, together with relevant encumbrance checks. | **Verify the ownership chain and fully diluted capitalisation and require effective Completion transfers and releases**; the register is important evidence but does not alone establish unencumbered title to all equity interests. |
| **SPA-N-016 — Tax/IP open terms** | Tax and IP warranties considered settled under the general regime. | A separate pre-Completion tax indemnity and suitable tax warranties, plus robust IP ownership, licensing and infringement warranties and the specific Ironquay protection. | **Reopen both categories**: seek tax survival of at least seven years, extended where assessment exposure remains, and tailored IP caps/survival; general 20%/18-month protection is inadequate for latent tax and core-IP risks. |

**Priority before signing:** secure Bluefen’s effective consent, Riverlark payoff/release mechanics, Ironquay ownership evidence, bonus allocation and an incident-response plan. None should be treated as resolved merely because it is disclosed.
=== END ADVICE ===
